newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan coalition parties agree on MOF reform.
newsitem.headline: Japan coalition parties agree on MOF reform.

text.p: The three parties in Japan's ruling coalition are to recommend that a body be set up to take over the Ministry of Finance's (MOF) role in inspecting and supervising the financial industry, a senior coalition official said on Wednesday.
The proposal is part of the coalition's MOF reform plan.

MOF, viewed as the pinnacle of Japan's elite bureaucracy, has come under fire for its handling of problems in the banking industry and has been urged to change its system of trying to deal with banking crises internally.
The plan will be endorsed by senior policy-makers later today, the official said.
